howToDefensiblyReach1100.verdict: We cannot reach 1,100 unique English pages by stretching generic sync/widget keywords or swapping iPhone/iPad titles. However, we CAN defensibly reach 1,100 unique, high-utility English pages (73 existing + 1,027 new) by partitioning the 1,027 new pages across 10 orthogonal, rule-driven clusters where each page has a distinct mathematical cycle, server protocol rule, RFC 5545 behavior, or diagnostic isolation test.

clusterBreakdown.C01-provider-sync-auth-architecture: 96 new (110 total) — server-by-server CalDAV/OAuth/EAS/Graph/ICS rules, admin consent, token revocation, delegation.
clusterBreakdown.C02-troubleshooting-failure-modes: 130 new (140 total) — symptom-specific failure isolation (modeled on BusyCal's 191 technical FAQs + Apple/Google/Microsoft support threads).
clusterBreakdown.C03-shift-work-and-rota-cycles: 119 new (120 total) — distinct industrial/medical/first-responder rota cycles (2-2-3 Panama, DuPont, Pitman, 24/48 Kelly days, 4-on-4-off, 7-on-7-off, ACGME call, offshore hitches), each with its own cycle math and recurrence recipe.
clusterBreakdown.C04-time-zones-dst-and-global-travel: 88 new (90 total) — asynchronous DST gap weeks (US/UK/EU/AU), non-DST jurisdictions, Date Line crossings, start/end TZID mismatches, multi-hub overlap tables.
clusterBreakdown.C05-tasks-reminders-and-time-blocking: 105 new (110 total) — due date vs do date, Maker vs Manager schedules, ADHD time-blindness anchors, buffer/travel padding, and specific task-bridge mechanics.
clusterBreakdown.C06-household-family-custody-and-educati: 105 new (110 total) — distinct co-parenting custody schedules (2-2-5-5, 2-2-3, 3-4-4-3, holiday overrides), eldercare shift handoffs, academic A/B block & lab schedules, short-term rental turnover ICS feeds.
clusterBreakdown.C07-meetings-invitations-rsvp-and-bookin: 97 new (105 total) — organizer vs attendee ownership, forwarded-invite bugs, room auto-decline rules, team PTO calendars, round-robin vs collective booking links.
clusterBreakdown.C08-weather-daylight-and-environmental-p: 79 new (90 total) — activity-specific meteorological thresholds (wind gusts, dew point, WBGT heat index, civil twilight, frost windows, tide/lunar feeds).
clusterBreakdown.C09-ios-system-widgets-shortcuts-and-cal: 95 new (105 total) — WidgetKit timeline limits, Apple Shortcuts calendar automations, Live Text flyer/screenshot extraction, VoiceOver legibility, and ISO-8601 / 4-4-5 fiscal / Hijri / Hebrew / Chinese calendrical math.
clusterBreakdown.C10-documented-competitor-and-workflow-c: 113 new (120 total) — source-backed architectural comparisons (Apple vs Google vs Outlook iOS apps, iPad Pencil PDF planners vs EventKit apps, BusyCal vs Fantastical, etc.).
